Subject: Post-discovery: locking kickoff, sample load + demo cadence

Hi Lena —

Great to talk earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: run a 45–60m technical sizing call to align on throughput/latency targets and validate a Dedicated GPU pool recommendation before a demo.
- Inputs we need before the call: a short load snapshot (peak qps, average request size in tokens or KB, percent requests using streaming), example prompt categories, and any SLAs you care about (p95 latency target, burst tolerance).
- Proposed attendees: your infra/ML engineer + product owner; from our side Mateo (tech lead) + Marissa (solutions lead) + myself.

Do any of these slots work for you next week?
  • Tue 2028-06-27 10:00–11:00 PT
  • Wed 2028-06-28 14:00–15:00 PT
  • Thu 2028-06-29 09:00–10:00 PT

If none work, send a couple alternative windows and we’ll accommodate. Also attached is a brief one-page kickoff agenda that we’ll walk through on the call. If convenient, can you attach a small sample load snapshot (CSV is fine) so Mateo can pre-run a capacity sketch prior to the call?

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Priyom

Priyom — thanks for the summary and the agenda. Quick answers:

- We can do Wed 2028-06-28 14:00–15:00 PT (works for our infra lead).
- Short snapshot attached: fintegral-load-snapshot.csv — contains 2 weeks of traffic with qps by endpoint and average payload sizes. The ‘chat’ endpoints tend to be heavier; about 25% of requests use streaming.
- P95 latency target is ~300ms for classification flows, 800ms for longer chat sessions; burst tolerance up to 3x baseline for 90s windows.

We’ll have our infra lead (Michael Lim) and product manager (Sara Voss) on the call. Procurement is cc’d; procurement will follow up separately on PO timing if we move forward.

See you on Wednesday — calendar invite attached.

— Lena
